**Finding submitted: deviation (T4C), preferred-level cure.**

- **Issue:** § 6(a) allows convenience termination only "at any time that there is no uncompleted Statement of Work outstanding," and § 2 makes the term open-ended. Clear Capital therefore has no convenience exit once an engagement is running, and § 6(b) covers only uncured material breach — failing both preferred and fallback (whose "end of a term" mechanic is inapplicable to an indefinite MSA).
- **Cure:** one inserted subsection 6(c) giving Company a 30-day convenience right over the Agreement or any SOW with a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees, plus an express bar on Contractor convenience termination while any SOW is outstanding. RadialSpark's residual 15-day right (only when nothing is in progress) and all other § 6 text are preserved verbatim.
